outgoingResource must be derived/read-only; client must not set it directly

Definition of 'retirement' value for needReasonId that exempts endDate requirement – exact ID or code not stated
Exact file-upload contract for the documents array (MIME types, size limits, multipart vs base64, field name)
Transaction behaviour across write operations (ASK record, comment, audit, task) – story explicitly marks this as unconfirmed (US-ASK-001-R51)
Authorization mechanism for 'Create New ASK' capability – token claim, role name, or permission code not specified
Meaning and intended cardinality of the duplicate numberofresources key in the request/response schema
Whether fYear and regionId are required or optional, and their validation rules
HTTP response status code for a successful Save & Exit vs successful SUBMIT (201 Created vs 200 OK not specified)
Whether the Exit (no-op) path should return a specific HTTP status code and response body or simply 204
Definition of 'new-version only' qualifier applied to pml, titlingCategory, and transitionalCoach – version discriminator field or endpoint variant not described

assumptions: Knowledge base returned HTTP 500 on both allowed attempts; DC Planner Reference, LLD Guidelines, DRT Compact API LLD Knowledge Base, DRT Master LLD, and DRT Workflow State Transitions could not be consulted. Card has been planned from ADO content alone and flagged differences/missing facts accordingly.
The duplicate numberofresources key in the JSON schema is treated as a data defect in the story, not as two separate fields.
buttonValue=Exit is treated as a no-op per the story assumption (US-ASK-001-R52); no separate change-note card is raised for it.
No Job, Integration, Notification, Data, or UI change items are described in the story; only one API card is produced.

story:
# [ADO STORY DETAILS]
- **Story ID:** 1857
- **Title:** Core ASK API – Create Core ASK (US-ASK-001)

## Description
User Story ID: US-ASK-001
As a permitted user,
I want to create and save or submit a new Core ASK through the API,
So that a new Core resource request can be captured for further processing.
Business Objective Enable authorized users to create new Core ASK records with validated business data and proper routing based on submission intent.
Feature Description This story covers the create Core ASK API, including field validation, conditional rules, optional draft save, submission routing, comment handling, and attachment payload support.
Scope – Included Create new Core ASK
Support Save & Exit, SUBMIT, and Exit button behaviors
Validate required and conditional fields
Support comment and documents payload
Set resulting workflow status based on button value and leadership-group condition
Scope – Excluded Amend existing Core ASK
Rotational ASK creation
Transaction implementation details not confirmed in current export
UI presentation and tooltip behavior
Preconditions Caller has permission to create a new ASK
Reference data values used in the request are valid and active
Request body is structurally valid
Postconditions For Save & Exit: draft data is saved with status 123 In Progress
For SUBMIT: ASK is created and routed to status 127 PPL Review for non-leadership submitters or 145 DPP Ops Review for leadership-group submitters
For Exit: no changes are persisted
Business Rules coreAskName is required and max 200 characters
dppGroupId is required and must be an active option
needReasonId, generalSpecialityNeedId, and levelNeedId are required
First needReasonId option clears outgoingResource, employeeId, projectedStartDate, and endDate
First generalSpecialityNeedId option clears generalSpecialityNeedComment
generalSpecialityNeedComment is required unless generalSpecialityNeedId is the first option
pml is optional, max 99 characters, new-version only
projectedStartDate is required
endDate is required unless needReasonId is retirement; must be greater than projectedStartDate and not earlier than today
outgoingResource is derived and read-only from selected employeeId
headCountAmount is required
fteAmount is required and must not exceed headCountAmount
rolePostingId is required only when levelNeedId is in the top-3 set
titlingCategory is required, new-version only
transitionalCoach is optional, max 99 characters, new-version only
roleSummary, roleResponsibility, and roleQualification are all required
buttonValue controls save/submit/exit behavior
Functional Requirements Expose POST /core-asks
Accept request body containing: coreAskDetails, comment, documents, buttonValue
Validate all field and business rules
On valid create, return new identifiers and created entities
Support request fields: coreAskName, dppGroupId, needReasonId, generalSpecialityNeedId, generalSpecialityNeedComment, levelNeedId, pml, projectedStartDate, endDate, outgoingResource, employeeId, headCountAmount, fteAmount, rolePostingId, titlingCategory, transitionalCoach, roleSummary, roleResponsibility, roleQualification
Validation Rules Required fields must be present when applicable
Max lengths must be enforced where specified
Reference IDs must map to valid active options
endDate must not be earlier than today
endDate must be after projectedStartDate
fteAmount must not exceed headCountAmount
rolePostingId must be present when required
generalSpecialityNeedComment must be present when required
Error Handling / Exception Scenarios Return 400 when required fields are missing
Return 400 for invalid active option selections such as invalid dppGroupId
Return 422 when endDate is earlier than today
Return 422 when endDate is not after projectedStartDate
Return 422 when fteAmount exceeds headCountAmount
API Details Endpoint: /core-asks
Method: POST
Request: { "coreAskDetails": { "coreAskName": "string", "fYear": int, "regionId": int, "dppGroupId": 0, "needReasonId": 0, "generalSpecialityNeedId": 0, "generalSpecialityNeedComment": "string", "levelNeedId": 0, "pml": "string", "projectedStartDate": "1970-01-01", "endDate": "1970-01-01", "outgoingResource": "string", "employeeId": 0, "headCountAmount": 0, "fteAmount": 0, "rolePostingId": 0, "numberofresources": 1, "titlingCategory": "string", "transitionalCoach": "string", "roleSummary": "string", "roleResponsibility": "string", "roleQualification": "string", "numberofresources": 2 }, "comment": "string", "documents": ["file upload array"], "buttonValue": "Save & Exit | SUBMIT | Exit" }
Response: { "askId": 12345, "askDetailId": 98765, "coreAskDetails": { ... }, "version": 1, "task": { "taskId": 0, "statusId": 0, "assigneeId": 0 }, "comment": { "commentId": 0 }, "auditHistory": { "auditId": 0 } }
Dependencies Reference data services for DPP Group, ASK Reason, Level, General/Specialty, Role Posting
Employee search/picker for employeeId
Attachment upload handling
Workflow status routing service
Authorization for Create New ASK capability
Assumptions Transaction behavior across write operations is not confirmed in the current export
buttonValue=Exit is treated as no-op and does not persist changes
Exact attachment file-upload contract is represented as "file upload array" in the source contract
Story Points 8
Definition of Done Endpoint validates required and conditional rules
Save, Submit, and Exit behaviors are implemented
Status routing works as defined
Positive and negative scenarios are tested
API contract and error mapping are documented
Acceptance Criteria
Scenario: Save Core ASK draft successfully
Given the caller provides valid Core ASK data and buttonValue is Save & Exit
When the client calls POST /core-asks
Then the API saves the ASK as draft with status 123 In Progress and returns the created identifiers
Scenario: Submit Core ASK as non-leadership user
Given the caller provides valid Core ASK data, is not in leadership group, and buttonValue is SUBMIT
When the client calls the create endpoint
Then the API creates the ASK and routes it to status 127 PPL Review
Scenario: Submit Core ASK as leadership user
Given the caller provides valid Core ASK data, is in leadership group, and buttonValue is SUBMIT
When the client calls the create endpoint
Then the API creates the ASK and routes it to status 145 DPP Ops Review
Scenario: Exit without save
Given the caller sends buttonValue as Exit
When the client calls the create endpoint
Then no data is saved
Scenario: FTE exceeds headcount
Given the request contains fteAmount greater than headCountAmount
When the client calls the create endpoint
Then the API returns 422
Scenario: Required field missing
Given the request omits a mandatory field
When the client calls the create endpoint
Then the API returns 400
Scenario: End date before projected start date
Given the request contains endDate not after projectedStartDate
When the client calls the create endpoint
Then the API returns 422
